label: 03 · New Arrivals
description: The weekly drop: how many new pieces came in, when they go out, and up to four of them as one mosaic of your photos - two side by side, three as one large and two small, four as a 2x2 - arriving one by one, the names and where to look beside them. Every picture edits on the canvas: drop a photo or a clip in, drag the area it fills, pick whether it covers or fits. With no photo of your own, real pieces from the starter pack stand in, never clip art.

platform.label: Platform
platform.description: Where the clip is going: feed 4:5 by default; story 9:16 and square 1:1 re-flow; landscape 16:9 and email 2:1 put the count beside the pieces. Sets the canvas when the resolution is left locked to the template.

brandName.label: Brand
brandName.description: The small wordmark on every frame. A logo replaces it. Required.

brandLogo.label: Brand logo
brandLogo.description: Zero or one logo in place of the wordmark: an image or a short muted looping video. Empty draws the brand name.

brandLogoRegion.label: Brand logo area
brandLogoRegion.description: Where the logo goes - or the brand name, when there is no logo - drawn on the preview: drag the rect to move it, pull a corner to resize it. Empty keeps its place in the layout.

brandLogoFit.label: Brand logo fit
brandLogoFit.description: contain shows the whole logo inside its area; cover fills the area and crops the logo's edges. Default: contain.

kicker.label: Kicker
kicker.description: Above the number, in the accent. Empty removes it.

count.label: Count
count.description: How many pieces came in, 1 to 9999, drawn large in the accent.

countLabel.label: Count noun
countLabel.description: The words after the number. Required.

whenLine.label: When
whenLine.description: The day and the hour, under the count. Empty removes it.
whenLine.placeholder: Friday at 10, in store and online

item1Name.label: Piece 1
item1Name.description: The first piece's name, in the line of names. Empty drops its tile; the others re-flow (two side by side, three as one large and two small, four as a 2x2).

item1Art.label: Piece 1 art
item1Art.description: The illustration that stands in when there is no photo: solitaire, band, pendant, studs, hoops, tennis, diamond, watch or ringbox. (Drawn only if the starter pack is missing.)

item1Image.label: Piece 1 photo or clip
item1Image.description: Zero or one photo or short clip of the piece. It fills its tile, cover-cropped, looping and muted if it moves. Empty shows a starter photo from the pack until you add yours.

item1ImageRegion.label: Piece 1 area
item1ImageRegion.description: Where the photo goes, drawn on the preview: drag the rect to move it, pull a corner to resize it - the photo fills the rect at its fit, so a tighter rect crops it. Empty keeps its tile in the layout.

item1ImageFit.label: Piece 1 fit
item1ImageFit.description: cover fills the tile and crops what spills over; contain shows all of it inside the tile, the page around it. Default: cover.

ctaLabel.placeholder: First look for subscribers Thursday night

ctaUrl.label: Link
ctaUrl.description: Where to go, under the call to action. Empty removes it.

metal.label: Metal tone
metal.description: The metal every bundled illustration is drawn in: gold, rose, white or platinum. (Drawn only if the starter pack is missing.)

stone.label: Stone tone
stone.description: The stone every bundled illustration is drawn with. (Drawn only if the starter pack is missing.)

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: ivory (warm paper, dark text), noir (near-black, light text), velvet (deep blue, ivory text) or blush (rose paper, brown text). Background and Text override either half.

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: The brand colour as #rrggbb: the count, the kicker and the progress line.

background.label: Background
background.description: The page colour as #rrggbb. Empty takes the theme's.

ink.label: Text
ink.description: The text colour as #rrggbb. Empty takes the theme's.

durationSec.label: Length (s)
durationSec.description: Clip length in whole seconds, 5 to 30. The count holds the first quarter while the pieces arrive; an explicit duration pin overrides it.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only: check the layout contract (every line fits its box) and draw it over the frame.
